text:
priya: FYI — incoming onboarding request from GreenCo. They want us to host a 7B domain-specialized chem-safety model in a private deployment with HSM. Customer note: must redact PII/PHI, run full safety evals, and complete rollout in ~3 weeks. I pasted the intake below and uploaded initial artifacts.

jamal: Thanks. Do we have model format and QPS? Any expectation on latency or token limits?

priya: Model is a finetuned transformer (.pt) + tokenizer. They plan to quantize to int8. QPS steady ~10, burst ~50. Target p50 <250ms for 512 tokens. Want canary for first 30 days and auto-rollback on safety regressions.

eric: Need sample prompt set + explicit failure cases. Can you ask them for 100 confirmed-fail cases and a 1.2k safety prompt suite? We'll compare against redwood-7b-v2. Also confirm whether they expect ONNX or torchserve artifacts for private.

deploy-bot: New intake created: INC-2026-1023 · assigned: platform-eng · priority: P2 · checklist ticket: CS-ONB-6789

priya: Uploaded the customer's CSV of examples + initial safety prompts to GS bucket: gs://redwood-cs/greenco/green_co_eval_v1.csv. Customer link (for reference): https://drive.google.com/greenco/chem-safety-v1

jamal: I'll set a quick sync w/eng + privacy tomorrow 10:00am PT. @eric will you own the eval harness? Also need to confirm HSM/KMS onboarding steps — customer requires key attestations.

eric: Taking lead on evals. I'll run baseline/regression tests. Running locally with existing harness: \n```\n./eval_runner --model-path s3://greenco/model.pt \\\n            --prompts gs://redwood-cs/greenco/green_co_eval_v1.csv \\\n            --baseline redwood-7b-v2 \\\n            --metrics hallucination,entity-masking,latency\n```\nWill check PII redaction and hallucination rates.

priya: :thumbsup: Also noted renewal-risk flag — procurement mentioned they might pilot other vendors if latency >300ms. We should prioritize p50 targets.

jamal: Noted. If quantized int8 can't meet latency/SLOs, recommend dedicated capacity or 4-bit quant + kernel tuning. Tagging privacy for PII masking validation in eval.

eric: Plan: run 5k prompts against baseline + customer model, compute F1 on NER, hallucination delta, and PII leakage checks. If quantization causes >2% F1 drop vs baseline we re-eval config. I expect initial results by EOD Friday.

priya: Customer also requires logs to be available to them but redacted. I'll confirm exact fields to redact and add to the intake checklist.

jamal: Good. For rollout: canary -> 20% -> 50% -> 100% over 2 weeks with automatic rollback on safety/regression alerts. I'll capture this in the rollout policy doc.

eric: One more ask — does GreenCo want inference in their VPC or our private infra? If VPC we need private network peering + HSM key provisioning steps.

priya: They prefer our private deployment inside a VPC with customer-managed HSM. I'll send the onboarding contract addendum and the HSM key exchange checklist.

jamal: OK — we'll cover infra and evauls at tomorrow's sync. Closing comments here; will update thread after the meeting and when EOD evals land.
